beats.why: Guess catches martyr but misses the resentment toward self and helped people; 'religion' read literally.
Guess says refusing is the threat, but narration says the incoming request is flagged as a threat.
Guess is garbled about altruism; vague on the objection that the reduction ignores true altruism.
Crossed-out approval addict gives only a partial read; narration moves to distinguishing conscious generosity from reflexive pleasing.
Presenter figure makes it seem the host explains, while narration is a speaker pushing back on workplace reality.
Angry other person suggests irritation at refusal, while narration only introduces addressing abrasiveness.
'Submit or reject?' is vague and guess drifts to a decision, missing the linguistics point.
Guess calls it an excuse, while narration is about how people react to the phrase.
Silence that follows is vague; the narration cuts off before the point.
'Look at the subtext' is generic and guess omits that it refers to I can't.
The power of a refusal is vague; narration is the host acknowledging I don't's empowerment before objecting.
Sad letter plus 'this one hurts' hints at emotion but not the scene transition.
Guess about a bucket for 'your refusal matters' is vague and misses the triggering vs causing point.
'A completely different sport' loses the sock-salesman versus marital-boundary contrast; guess says work.
Angry face with shield suggests anger and guess adds guilt, not the narrated muscle-memory protection.
Guess about sorting relationships into two types misses that a boundary can reveal transactional ones.
